newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Optus says 1st half on target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Optus says 1st half on target.

text.p: Telecommunications group Optus Communications said on Thursday its performance in the six months ended December 31 had been in line with its expectations.
"Basically, first half year performance has been in line with our expecatations," chief executive Ziggy Switkowski told a business luncheon.
Switkowski said Optus had achieved positive earnings in 1995/96. "Since then, in a heartening way, the profit trend has continued to look quite good," he said.
Optus reported a pre-tax profit of A$60.3 million for the year to June 30, 1996.
Optus is 25 percent owned by Mayne Nickless Ltd, and 24.5 percent each by BellSouth Corp and Cable and Wireless Plc.
Optus had planned to float on the Australian Stock Exchange by the end of calendar 1996, but litigation between the Seven Network Ltd and shareholders of its pay television associate, Optus Vision.
